summary: SF_STAIR_RAILING_NC_STAIN_v1 draft artifacts pass all critical validation checks. 38 tasks thread correctly between sop_modules.json and production.json. All IDs use RLST prefix. Multi-item architecture (railing LF, baluster EA, newel EA) correctly handled with component-specific stain rates and FIXED times for shared tasks. Wood-only scope correctly excludes iron substrate handling. No blockers.

issues.description: Many tasks use FIXED time based on 'typical 39-baluster system'. For significantly larger or smaller systems, engine should scale these times by component count ratio.
issues.suggested_fix: Document scaling factor in engine implementation notes. Consider converting to per-component rates in future iteration.

issues.description: TSK_RLST_STAIN_COAT_2_APPLY uses single FIXED time for all components instead of component-specific rates like coat 1.
issues.suggested_fix: Acceptable for initial draft. May split into component-specific coat 2 tasks if precision needed.
